library(tidyverse)

# Load LLM False Belief Data

```{r}
# setwd("/Users/seantrott/Dropbox/UCSD/Research/NLMs/epistemology/dev_tom/src/analysis")

# Grab data for false belief task
directory_path <- "../../data/processed/fb_local_control/"
csv_files <- list.files(path = directory_path, pattern = "*.csv", full.names = TRUE)
csv_list <- csv_files %>%
  map(~ read_csv(.))
df_all_models <- bind_rows(csv_list) %>%
  mutate(model_shorthand = str_to_title(model_shorthand))
nrow(df_all_models)
```

## Param lookup

```{r param_lookup}
# Map model names to parameter counts for ordering
param_lookup <- tibble(
  model_shorthand = c("Pythia 14m", "Pythia 1b", "Pythia 6.9b", "Pythia 12b",
                       "Olmo 2 1b", "Olmo 2 7b", "Olmo 2 13b"),
  n_params = c(14e6, 1e9, 6.9e9, 12e9, 1e9, 7e9, 13e9),
  model_family = c("Pythia", "Pythia", "Pythia", "Pythia",
                    "OLMo 2", "OLMo 2", "OLMo 2")
)
```


## Accuracy metric


### Over time

```{r accuracy_over_time}
### Correct answer is always end location in control task
df_all_models = df_all_models %>%
  mutate(correct = log_odds < 0)



df_summ = df_all_models %>%
  left_join(param_lookup, by = "model_shorthand") %>%
  group_by(model_shorthand, n_params, model_family, step, condition, knowledge_cue) %>%
  summarise(mean_accuracy = mean(correct),
            mean_lo = mean(log_odds),
            .groups = "drop")

df_summ %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = step,
             y = mean_accuracy,
             color = condition,
             linetype = knowledge_cue)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = .5, linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = .4) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  theme_minimal() +
  facet_wrap(~model_shorthand)

df_summ %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = step,
             y = mean_lo,
             color = condition,
             linetype = knowledge_cue)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = .4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  theme_minimal() +
  facet_wrap(~model_shorthand)




summary(lmer(data = df_all_models,
        log_odds ~ condition + knowledge_cue +
          first_mention + recent_mention + 
          log10(step + 1) +
         # log10(n_params) +
          (1|start) +
          (1 | model_shorthand)))




df_all_models %>%
  group_by(model_shorthand) %>%
  mutate(max_step = max(step)) %>%
  filter(step == max_step) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = log_odds,
             y = condition,
             fill = knowledge_cue)) +
  geom_density_ridges(alpha = .4) +
  theme_minimal() +
  facet_wrap(~model_shorthand)

```


### Final checkpoint (aligned with FB task)

```{r accuracy_final_checkpoint}
df_all_models %>%
  group_by(model_shorthand) %>%
  summarise(max_step = max(step))


df_summ_lo <- df_all_models %>%
  group_by(model_shorthand) %>%
  mutate(max_step = max(step)) %>%
  filter(step == max_step) %>%
  left_join(param_lookup, by = "model_shorthand") %>%
  group_by(model_shorthand, n_params, model_family, condition, knowledge_cue) %>%
  summarise(mean_lo = mean(log_odds),
            se_lo = sd(log_odds) / sqrt(n()),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(model_shorthand = fct_reorder(model_shorthand, n_params))

df_summ_lo %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = model_shorthand,
             y = mean_lo,
             fill = condition,
             alpha = knowledge_cue,
             group = interaction(condition, knowledge_cue))) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.6) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_lo - se_lo, ymax = mean_lo + se_lo),
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted") +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("Explicit" = 1, "Implicit" = 0.5)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Model", y = "Mean Log Odds", alpha = "Knowledge Cue") +
  facet_wrap(~model_family, scales = "free_x")


df_summ %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(model_shorthand, n_params),
             y = mean_accuracy,
             fill = condition,
             alpha = knowledge_cue)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = .5, linetype = "dotted") +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("Explicit" = 1, "Implicit" = 0.5)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Model", y = "Mean Accuracy", alpha = "Knowledge Cue") +
  facet_wrap(~model_family, scales = "free_x")


## scaling_results_rq1
df_summ %>%
  group_by(model_shorthand, n_params) %>%
  summarise(mean_accuracy = mean(mean_accuracy), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = n_params,
             y = mean_accuracy)) +
  geom_point(size = 6,
             alpha = .5) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label=model_shorthand), size=3) +
  labs(x = "Parameters",
       y = "Mean Accuracy") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 15),
        legend.position = "bottom") 



### Statistical analysis
df_final = df_all_models %>%
  group_by(model_shorthand) %>%
  mutate(max_step = max(step)) %>%
  filter(step == max_step) %>%
  inner_join(param_lookup, by = "model_shorthand")



results <- map_dfr(unique(df_final$model_shorthand), function(m) {
  df_m <- df_final %>% filter(model_shorthand == m)
  mod <- lmer(log_odds ~ condition + knowledge_cue +
                first_mention + recent_mention +
                (1 | start),
              data = df_m)
  broom.mixed::tidy(mod, effects = "fixed") %>%
    filter(term %in% c("conditionTrue Belief", "knowledge_cueImplicit")) %>%
    mutate(model = m)
})

results %>%
  dplyr::select(model, term, estimate, std.error, p.value) %>%
  arrange(term, model) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

results %>%
  left_join(param_lookup, by = c("model" = "model_shorthand")) %>%
  mutate(model = fct_reorder(model, n_params)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = model, y = estimate, color = term)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, position = position_dodge(width = 0.4)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = estimate - std.error,
                     ymax = estimate + std.error),
                width = 0.2,
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.4)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Model", y = "Coefficient (log odds)",
       color = "Term") +
  facet_wrap(~model_family, scales = "free_x")

```
